title: Society, law and power
theme: justice, politics and the wider world
goal: Recognise and use 24 frequent words for justice, politics, power and nationalities, as heard in the news.

example.fr: Mon avocate m'aide avec ma demande de résidence permanente.
example.en: My lawyer is helping me with my permanent residence application.

items.note: Un avocat is also an avocado.

items.en: panel of jurors (trial); panel of judges (contest)

example.fr: Le jury a rendu sa décision après trois jours.
example.en: The jury reached its decision after three days.

example.fr: C'est une accusation très grave.
example.en: That's a very serious accusation.

example.fr: Pour ce poste, l'employeur vérifie si vous avez un dossier criminel.
example.en: For this job, the employer checks whether you have a criminal record.

items.note: A criminal record: un casier judiciaire (standard); un dossier criminel is common in Québec.

example.fr: Le nombre de crimes a baissé dans notre quartier.
example.en: The number of crimes has gone down in our neighbourhood.

example.fr: Je suis allée au commissariat pour signaler le vol de mon vélo.
example.en: I went to the police station to report my stolen bike.

example.fr: Les prisonniers peuvent recevoir des visites le dimanche.
example.en: Prisoners can have visitors on Sundays.

items.en: cell (in a prison or the body)

example.fr: Le corps humain contient des milliards de cellules.
example.en: The human body contains billions of cells.

example.fr: Au Québec, il est illégal d'utiliser son cellulaire en conduisant.
example.en: In Québec, it's illegal to use your cell phone while driving.

example.fr: Il a été victime d'une agression dans le métro.
example.en: He was the victim of an assault in the subway.

example.fr: Ce film contient trop de violence pour les enfants.
example.en: This movie has too much violence for children.

example.fr: Il faut signaler le problème aux autorités.
example.en: The problem must be reported to the authorities.

example.fr: Au Canada, le gouverneur général représente le roi.
example.en: In Canada, the Governor General represents the King.

example.fr: La sénatrice a posé une question au ministre.
example.en: The senator asked the minister a question.

example.fr: Elle participe à un congrès médical à Ottawa.
example.en: She's attending a medical conference in Ottawa.

example.fr: La France est divisée en départements.
example.en: France is divided into departments.

items.en: a people or country (as a community)

example.fr: Les Premières Nations vivent ici depuis des milliers d'années.
example.en: First Nations have lived here for thousands of years.

example.fr: La Chine est une grande puissance économique.
example.en: China is a major economic power.

example.fr: Avec mes cousins, on est une vraie tribu !
example.en: With my cousins, we're a real tribe!

example.fr: Au bureau, il y a deux clans qui ne se parlent pas.
example.en: At the office, there are two cliques that don't talk to each other.

example.fr: Il a perdu tous ses biens dans l'incendie.
example.en: He lost all his possessions in the fire.

example.fr: Mon collègue est allemand ; il vient de Berlin.
example.en: My colleague is German; he's from Berlin.

example.fr: J'adore la cuisine japonaise.
example.en: I love Japanese food.

example.fr: Elle parle russe et ukrainien.
example.en: She speaks Russian and Ukrainian.

blocks.title: Usage tips
blocks.body:
**False friends:** [[un avocat]] is a lawyer (or an avocado); [[un congrès]] is usually a conference.

**Québec:** a criminal record is often [[un dossier criminel]] (standard everywhere: [[un casier judiciaire]]), a police station is [[un poste de police]], and a cell phone is [[un cellulaire]]. Nationality adjectives take no capital.

blocks.prompt: Amira says: “Je vais à un congrès à Ottawa.” Where is she going?
blocks.explain: [[Un congrès]] is usually a conference or convention.

blocks.prompt: Your bike was stolen in Montréal. Where do you report it?
blocks.explain: In Québec, people say [[le poste de police]]; in France, [[le commissariat]].

accept: Il est illégal de fumer ici.
blocks.explain: [[Il est illégal de]] / [[C'est illégal de]] + infinitive.

blocks.prompt: My lawyer (a woman) is very good.
blocks.explain: [[Avocate]] starts with a vowel, so use [[mon]]: [[mon avocate]].

blocks.text: Ce film contient trop de ___ pour les enfants.
blocks.en: This movie has too much violence for children.

blocks.explain: [[La cuisine]] is feminine → [[japonaise]], with no capital.
[[accusation]] has two c and one s.

summary:
- Follow news about justice: [[un avocat, une accusation, illégal, la violence]]
- Talk about power and politics: [[les autorités, une puissance, un sénateur, un congrès]]
- Know the Québec terms [[poste de police]], [[dossier criminel]], [[cellulaire]]
